appearances.whereabouts: Campsite by the pool with Egwene, then fleeing and hiding under stone hand, captured by Whitecloaks, held in Bornhald's tent
appearances.notable_actions: Contemplates throwing away his axe; receives wolf-sending warning of approaching men; helps douse fire and flee with Egwene; hides under fragment of Artur Hawkwing statue; experiences Hopper's death directly through wolf bond; attacks Whitecloaks in berserker rage after Hopper is killed; kills two Children of the Light; is knocked unconscious and captured; is bound heavily with ropes; tells truth (mostly) to Bornhald about their origins; is struck by Byar with his own axe; loses all contact with wolves and Elyas by chapter's end
appearances.demeanor: Conflicted, ashamed of his pride in the axe, protective of Egwene, increasingly merged with wolf consciousness (seeing in dark, experiencing Hopper's perspective), terrified when Hopper dies, berserker rage during attack, dazed and wounded after capture, defiant toward Byar, frightened of Bornhald's judgment

appearances.whereabouts: Campsite by the fire, fleeing on Bela, hiding under stone hand, captured, held in Bornhald's tent
appearances.notable_actions: Sits by fire staring at statue fragment; reluctantly douses fire when Elyas orders; flees with Perrin on Bela; hides under Artur Hawkwing's hand; is captured by Whitecloaks; bound heavily with ropes; tries to comfort Perrin; leaps into conversation to cover gaps in his story (inventing the Baerlon meeting with the Warder); nearly struck by Byar; tells Bornhald about Trollocs' varied features
appearances.demeanor: Tired and frightened, tries to be brave, attempts to comfort Perrin, quick-thinking in creating cover story, stubborn (Perrin sees her jaw set), increasingly scared as situation worsens

appearances.whereabouts: Campsite, then disappears into the night to hunt with wolves
appearances.notable_actions: Confronts Perrin about his feelings toward Egwene and the axe; counsels him about when to throw it away; receives wolf-sending about approaching men; rushes to warn them; orders fire doused; tells Perrin and Egwene to hide while he joins the wolves; stalks the night with his long knife as 'a two-legged wolf with one sharp steel tooth'; helps wolves drive off or kill Whitecloaks; disappears—Perrin cannot sense him by chapter's end
appearances.demeanor: Pragmatic, harsh but caring teacher, urgent and desperate when danger approaches, merges with wolf pack during the fight

appearances.whereabouts: With the wolf pack, then attacks Whitecloaks at the hiding place
appearances.notable_actions: Injured earlier (gash down face, left eye gone); sends urgent warning to Perrin; attacks Whitecloaks who threaten Perrin; leaps at the leader who has lance pointed at Perrin; kills that Whitecloak by crushing his throat; is pinned to earth by two lances; snaps at the shafts while dying; dies while trying to leap one last time
appearances.demeanor: Wounded but fierce, protective of Perrin (his 'brother'), yearning to soar like eagles even in death, brave and selfless

appearances.whereabouts: With the wolf pack, hunting in the night around the pool
appearances.notable_actions: Sends warnings to Perrin about the approaching men and their 'wrong' smell; injured by ravens but still fights; helps coordinate attacks on Whitecloaks and their horses; survives the encounter but contact is lost
appearances.demeanor: Injured, alert, protective, coordinating pack tactics

appearances.whereabouts: With the wolf pack around the pool
appearances.notable_actions: Injured by ravens; was seen by the Whitecloaks, triggering their search; participates in attacks on horses and men during the night

appearances.whereabouts: With the wolf pack around the pool
appearances.notable_actions: Participates in coordinated attacks on Whitecloaks during the night hunt

appearances.whereabouts: In his command tent with prisoners
appearances.notable_actions: Interrogates Perrin and Egwene after their capture; examines Perrin's belongings including the Tar Valon coin; holds and studies Perrin's axe; rebukes Byar for wanting a wolf-hide rug and for overestimating enemy numbers; questions prisoners about their story; tests their knowledge of geography and Trollocs; prevents Byar from executing them immediately; decides to take them to Amador via Caemlyn; offers them chance to 'come to the Light' and confess; reveals Perrin faces the gibbet for killing two Children; orders them to march at dawn despite loss of horses
appearances.demeanor: Grandfatherly, calm, thoughtful, methodical, seems kind but inflexible in duty, believes he is offering mercy, regretful but determined about handing them to Questioners if they don't confess

appearances.whereabouts: In Bornhald's tent, reporting and guarding prisoners
appearances.notable_actions: Reports casualties to Bornhald (9 dead, 23 injured, 30 horses killed); estimates enemy numbers at 50+ wolves and dozen+ men (Bornhald corrects to 6-8 wolves); had Hopper skinned for a rug; examines and admires Perrin's axe; strikes Perrin with axe handle when he protests being called Darkfriend; threatens to strike Egwene; threatens to cut out their tongues; insists they should be executed immediately as Darkfriends; is rebuked by Bornhald for overzealousness; returns prisoners' belongings (minus weapons) on Bornhald's order
appearances.demeanor: Rigid, emotionless voice, burning hatred in sunken eyes, moves like a snake, cruel without passion, considers executing prisoners a simple duty, deeply offended when rebuked by Bornhald, hates prisoners more after being humiliated in front of them

relationships.description: Childhood friends from Two Rivers; Perrin loves her (not romantically—she and Rand are together); he is protective of her and nearly killed her to spare her from ravens; she tries to comfort him and covers gaps in his story to Bornhald
